Anthony, your order Shop···· for the Harlo B30 came through. The first $424.24 is paid on your Mastercard ending ····. The remaining $464.25 is what goes on your second card.

If the Pay now button isn't there, tell me.

I WANT TO PAY THE REST OF THIS ORDER!
=

I've emailed you a payment link for the remaining $464.25. It went to (email hidden) just now, so check your spam folder if you don't see it.

Open the email and pay with your second card. Once the balance is paid, the hold comes off and your B30 goes out with the current batch by November 30.

Tell me if the link doesn't arrive or your card gets declined.
I LITTERLY WANT TO GIVE YOU MONEY!

I hear you, and I'm sorry this is fighting you. The $464.25 hasn't gone through on our side yet, and I don't see an attempt to pay it since I sent the link.

Earlier tonight, before the first half went through, one card was declined by the bank as suspected fraud and another for insufficient funds. A quick call to the bank usually clears a fraud block.

What happens when you try? Is the email missing, or does the card get declined on the payment page?
